criteria.name: banner
criteria.expect: a 64 high banner at the top of the phone, filled #fde8e8, padding 0 16, row align center, gap 12

criteria.name: text
criteria.expect: a 14 pt #b42318 text Something went wrong that fills the row

criteria.name: retry
criteria.expect: a secondary Retry button at the right of the banner

criteria.name: list
criteria.expect: five 56 high white rows below the banner, in order

criteria.name: render
criteria.expect: render Empty.Empty: a red banner over a five-row list, no warnings
